traits.name: Steady hands
traits.text: Eleven years of setting charges, and you still have all ten fingers.

traits.name: Thick skull
traits.text: A rockfall in the Tailings put you out for one shift. Just the one.

traits.name: Quick feet
traits.text: First one out when the roof creaks.

traits.name: Low profile
traits.text: You learned to keep your head down before you learned to read.

traits.name: Patched suit
traits.text: More tape than suit by now, but it holds.

traits.name: Hothead
traits.text: Shoot first. Apologize to the Company later.
